slice: Husqvarna owner's-manual suspension tables 2020-2026 (FC, TC, FX, FE, TE, TX) - Round 2 fill

records.statement: Husqvarna's 2023 manual sets the FC 350 air fork at 10.3 bar (149 psi) on EU bikes and 10.6 bar (154 psi) on US bikes, and the FX 350 at 9.9 bar (144 psi); shock springs are 42/45/48 N/mm for 65-75/75-85/85-95 kg riders with 8 mm preload, 35 mm static and 105 mm riding sag.

values.standard_rider_weight: 75-85 kg (165-187 lb) in full riding gear
values.fork_position: 2nd milled groove from top flush with upper edge of upper triple clamp (no mm height given)

source.name: Husqvarna Motorcycles Owner's Manual 2023 FC 350 / FX 350 (art. no. 3402632en), dealer-hosted copy

records.notes: Values from chapter 10 (Tuning the chassis), which repeats them per variant (FC 350 EU F2201W1, FC 350 US F2275W1, FX 350 F2201W6). Air fork: left leg air spring, steel spring only as end stop, so no fork spring rate. Technical-data chapter (22.7/22.8) was cut off in extraction. Same shock chart and clicker presets as the 2023 FC/FX 450 (km8-016); fork air 0.1 bar lower than the 450 per variant.

records.topic: owner's-manual fork technical data: 2021 FC 450 / FX 450
records.statement: Husqvarna's 2021 FC 450 technical data lists the WP XACT 5448 air fork at 10.7 bar (155 psi) for the US FC 450 and 10 bar (145 psi) for the second fork variant, with fork clickers at 17/12/7 compression and 23/18/13 rebound (comfort/standard/sport).

values.standard_rider_weight: 75 kg ... (value cut off in preview; same manual family uses 75-85 kg)

source.name: Husqvarna Motorcycles Owner's Manual 2021 FC 450 / FX 450 / FC 450 Rockstar Edition (art. no. 3402445en), technical data 22.7.2-22.7.3, manual-hosting site page view

records.notes: Page text extraction did not pair columns cleanly; the US FC 450 label for 10.7 bar is explicit in the cartridge-oil line, the second column's model is not labelled (950 mm length and 10 bar fit the FX 450, cf. 2023 FX 450 at 10.1 bar). EU FC 450 value not visible. Shock spring chart, sag and preload pages could not be loaded (site served other pages).

records.topic: owner's-manual shock technical data: 2022 FC 250 (completes km8-019)
records.statement: Husqvarna's 2022 FC 250 technical data lists WP XACT shock springs of 39/42/45 N/mm for 65-75/75-85/85-95 kg riders and 35 mm static sag; shock clickers read 17/15/13 low-speed, 2/1.5/1 turns high-speed and 17/15/13 rebound (comfort/standard/sport).

source.name: Husqvarna Motorcycles Owner's Manual 2022 FC 250 (art. no. 3402532en), technical data 22.8, manual-hosting site page view

records.notes: Extracted text was scrambled and values were matched to labels by order; spring chart agrees with the partial km8-019 preview (39/42) and adds the 85-95 kg row (45 N/mm). Riding sag, shock preload and fork air pressure were not on this page. Fork clicker figures sat in the adjacent fork block and their mapping is inferred.

records.statement: Husqvarna's 2021 TC 125 manual gives a guideline fork air pressure of 8.1 bar (117 psi) for the 75-85 kg standard rider, adjustable from 7 to 12 bar in 0.2 bar steps.

source.name: Husqvarna Motorcycles Owner's Manual 2021 TC 125, sections 10 and 10.13, manual-hosting site page views

records.notes: The 8.1 bar figure appears in the 10.13 'Adjusting the fork air pressure' guideline box but was unlabelled in the extracted text; its role as the setting is inferred from the standard KTM-group box layout (setting, step, min, max). Plausible against the sister 2021 KTM 125 SX at 8.3 bar (km8-005). Standard rider weight from page 36. Shock spring chart, sag and clicker pages could not be loaded.

records.topic: owner's-manual fork air pressure and clickers: 2022 TX 300i
records.statement: Husqvarna's 2022 TX 300i manual gives a guideline fork air pressure of 9.6 bar (139 psi), adjustable from 7 to 12 bar in 0.2 bar steps, with fork compression clickers at 17/12/7 (comfort/standard/sport).

source.name: Husqvarna Motorcycles Owner's Manual 2022 TX 300i, sections 10.13-10.14, manual-hosting site page views

records.notes: TX 300i is the 2022 US cross-country 2-stroke (TBI; later named TX 300). 9.6 bar was unlabelled in extraction and inferred as the setting from box layout; compression clicks from page 48 with label mapping by order. Air-fork value is lower than the MX TC 250-class 10.4 bar, consistent with an off-road setup. Shock data not reached.

records.topic: stock fork air and shock spring: 2024 FC 250
records.statement: The 2024 FC 250 comes with its WP XACT air fork set at 10.5 bar and a 42 N/mm shock spring as stock.

source.name: Dirt Rider, 2024 Husqvarna FC 250 Technical Information

records.notes: Manufacturer stock settings as reported by a magazine (photo captions, unit written as 'Nm'); not taken from the owner's manual. No rider-weight band, sag or clicker data. 42 N/mm matches the 75-85 kg spring of the 2022 FC 250 chart (km9c-003).

conflicts.spread: 10 bar (2021 manual, column label inferred) vs 10.1 bar (2023 manual, km8-016)
conflicts.note: Different model years; 2021 attribution uncertain. Not a true conflict unless the 2021 column is confirmed as FX 450.
